newsitem.title: USA: President Clinton leaves for Helsinki summit.
newsitem.headline: President Clinton leaves for Helsinki summit.

text.p: President Clinton left on Wednesday night for a two-day summit with Russian President Boris Yeltsin in Finland expected to focus on Moscow's opposition to NATO expansion, as well as arms control reduction and economic issues.

The wheelchair-bound Clinton, who underwent knee surgery last Friday to reattach a torn tendon suffered when he stumbled on some stairs, arrived at Andrews Air Force Base in a specially equipped white van.
The president, preceeded by his doctor carrying a set of crutches, was rolled onto a platform elevator and lifted aboard Air Force One.
Yeltsin and Clinton will meet on Thursday and Friday in Helsinki. Both U.S. and Russian officials said they expected no dramatic breakthroughs, but hoped for progress on issues of mutual interest.
